questions.question: By the time I finished my homework, it was already midnight. I had been studying for five hours.
options: I had just started
I had been studying for three hours
I had finished two hours ago
I had never studied before
questions.answer: I had been studying for five hours

questions.question: She looks more tired than I do.
options: She is as tired as me
She looks less tired than I am
She is not as tired as me
She is much more tired
questions.answer: She looks more tired than I do

questions.question: If it rains tomorrow, the concert will be cancelled.
options: The concert won't be cancelled if it doesn't rain
It's not sure whether the concert will be cancelled
The concert will definitely happen
It will only be postponed
questions.answer: If it rains tomorrow, the concert will be cancelled

questions.question: I'm not sure if I'll be able to come to the party tonight.
options: I definitely won't be able to come
I might not be able to come
I probably won't be able to come
It's unlikely that I'll go
questions.answer: I'm not sure if I'll be able to come to the party tonight

questions.question: The manager asked me to take a break and then continue with my work.
options: He told me to finish my work first
He said I could do whatever I wanted
He ordered me to stop working immediately
He suggested I should have a rest
questions.answer: The manager asked me to take a break and then continue with my work

questions.question: I love reading books, but I also enjoy watching movies.
options: I prefer reading books
I hate watching movies
I don't like reading books
I only watch movies
questions.answer: I love reading books, but I also enjoy watching movies

questions.question: The weather forecast says it will be sunny tomorrow.
options: It's going to rain tomorrow
We can't know for sure what the weather will be like
There is no chance of sunshine
It might not be sunny
questions.answer: The weather forecast says it will be sunny tomorrow

questions.question: I've been living in this city for three years now.
options: I have lived here for one year
I moved here last week
It's my first day in the city
I'm still a student
questions.answer: I've been living in this city for three years now

questions.question: The new employee is more experienced than I am.
options: She has less experience
We have the same amount of experience
He is not as experienced
I'm more experienced
questions.answer: The new employee is more experienced than I am

questions.question: By the time you finish your degree, you will have studied for four years.
options: You will have been studying for three years
You will never study again
It's not sure how long you'll study
You will have finished your degree
questions.answer: By the time you finish your degree, you will have studied for four years
